name: PT Panin Financial Tbk
summary: PT Panin Financial Tbk provides Sharia banking and financial services in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Life Insurance and Business Consulting Service; and Banking and Multi-finance. The company offers life insurance products, including death, whole life, annuity, endowment, endowment combine, universal life, unit-linked, personal accident, and health insurance, as well as business consulting, management, and administration services. It also provides management consulting services in the field of archives; and mutual fund and investing services.
